findings.charge: The Measured-inputs recital mislabels leftover-join.v8's Stage A standing as `split Dual REJECT`. In this lineage `split` and `Dual REJECT` are mutually exclusive terms for Stage A verdict standing, and v8 is Dual REJECT, not split.
evidence: Live Stage A bytes: platform-tcb-leftover-join.v8.review-independent.claude2.json verdict=REJECT (blockers 0, mustFix 0, shouldFix 1) and platform-tcb-leftover-join.v8.review-independent.codex.json verdict=REJECT / verdictFinal=REJECT (shouldFix [CODEX-PTLJ-V8-SF1]). Both reviewers REJECTed. Nothing about v8's Stage A was split.

Live Stage A bytes for v7: platform-tcb-leftover-join.v7.review-independent.claude2.json verdict=REJECT; platform-tcb-leftover-join.v7.review-independent.codex.json verdict=ACCEPT. v7 is the split one.

The frozen subject-of-record itself draws the distinction three times and never fuses the terms. platform-tcb-leftover-join.v9.json basedOn.predecessorV7.role: 'Split. Claude REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V7-SF1. Codex ACCEPT 0/0. Not Dual REJECT. Not Dual ACCEPT.' basedOn.predecessorV8.role: 'Dual REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V8-SF1 / CODEX-PTLJ-V8-SF1 ... CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED.' registerRowNote: v7 '(split Claude REJECT ... ; not Dual ACCEPT; not Dual REJECT)', v8 '(Dual REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V8-SF1 / CODEX-PTLJ-V8-SF1)'. remeasurementClause: 'Frozen leftover-join.v7 remains a split CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED', 'Frozen leftover-join.v8 remains Dual REJECT CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED.' The word 'split' is reserved for v7 in every one of these sites, and v7's own note says 'not Dual REJECT' precisely because it is split.
The review prompt draws the same line: 'leftover-join.v7 is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED (split; not Dual ACCEPT).' / 'leftover-join.v8 is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED (Dual REJECT).'

The phrase 'split Dual REJECT' appears nowhere in COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md. Where COORD uses 'split' it means reviewer disagreement (line 12967, 'Turn 2 split: Claude ...'). The construction is novel to this draft.

The parallel construction inside the draft's own table forces the wrong reading. Line 80: 'split Dual REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V8-SF1 / CODEX-PTLJ-V8-SF1'. Line 81: 'split Claude REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V7-SF1 / Codex ACCEPT'. In line 81 'split' unambiguously modifies the verdict pair; by exact parallelism line 80 asserts v8's verdicts were split. They were not.

This is the first COORD text ever to characterize v7 or v8. COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md cites platform-tcb-leftover-join only at D-185 (v6). v7 and v8 were never recorded, so adoption writes this characterization into the permanent record with no prior COORD entry to correct it.
findings.whyNotMustFix: The digest, both identifiers, CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, 'not current' and 'not this subject' are all correct on the row, and the draft states v8's standing correctly at line 121 ('leftover-join.v7 split plus leftover-join.v8 Dual REJECT'). No count, currency, gate, obligation or SATISFIED consequence turns on the word. The defect is confined to the recital.
findings.remedy: Delete the word 'split' from the leftover-join.v8 row so it reads 'Frozen leftover-join.v8 (Dual REJECT CLAUDE-PTLJ-V8-SF1 / CODEX-PTLJ-V8-SF1; CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; not current; not this subject)'. Leave line 81 unchanged; 'split' is correct there.
